k13-friede-basel.beschreibung: Negotiations for the Peace of Basel in 1499 at the end of the Swabian War . The Milanese envoy Galeazzo Visconti presents his peace proposals to the delegation of Holy Roman Emperor Maximilian I at the city hall of Basel . A delegate from Lucerne (front left, in the blue-white dress) translates.
